items.english: Let's use the "du" (informal) form of address with each other.

exercises.title: A friend of Sebastian's
texts: Bring den Dialog in die richtige Reihenfolge. Beginne mit: „Ich heiße Stefan Müller, ich bin ein Freund von Sebastian.“

Ich heiße Stefan Müller. Ich bin ein Freund von Sebastian. Und ich bin Nico González. Woher kommen Sie? Aus Deutschland. Aber wollen wir uns nicht duzen? Gern. Ich bin Nico. Woher kommst du, Nico? Ich komme aus Spanien.

exercises.title: Asking questions
texts: Did you know? When getting to know someone, it's always interesting to talk about their country of origin or hometown. If you don't know someone all that well, you should not talk about private topics.

texts: Info: Lisa's friends use "du" to address Nico, even though they don't know each other. This is normal among young people.

exercises.title: Where are you from?
texts: Did you know? People only ask for someone's telephone number and address when they know each other a little better and are sure that they would like to meet again.

pages.title: What is your living situation?
texts:
More than half of all apartments in Germany are rented. For a rented apartment, you have to pay a monthly rent plus additional costs, like electricity, heat, water, and trash collection. People who own an apartment or a house also have to pay these extra costs, as well as property tax.
Nearly one in five people lives alone. In big cities, more than a third of all apartments are occupied by just one person. Living space in Germany, particularly in cities like Berlin, Munich, Hamburg and Cologne, is limited and expensive. That's why students in cities with universities often share an apartment, called a "Wohngemeinschaft" or "WG" for short.

lines: (3) In company | Was machst du hier?
Nico meets Lisa’s roommates, Sebastian and Nina, who are hanging fairy
lights up in the courtyard. After they have introduced themselves, Lisa asks
whether Nico can stay in the shared apartment for the next few days.
Hi, Lisa! Wer ist denn das?

weg. Und Yaras Adresse ist auch weg.
